chapters.title: Merge sort

frames.caption: Merge sort — O(n log n) time, O(n) extra space. Input: sort_array(nums=[3, 1, 3, 0]). Step through to watch the code work on this input.
out, i, j = [], 0, 0 — 3 pushed on the front of nums; left = [3]; right = [1]; out = []; …
while i < len(left) and j < len(right): → true (i = 0, j = 0)
if left[i] <= right[j]: → false (i = 0, j = 0) (<= keeps it stable)
while i < len(left) and j < len(right): → false (i = 0, j = 1)
out, i, j = [], 0, 0 — 3 pushed on the front of nums; left = [3]; right = [0]; out = []; …
while i < len(left) and j < len(right): → true (i = 0, j = 0)
if left[i] <= right[j]: → false (i = 0, j = 0) (<= keeps it stable)
while i < len(left) and j < len(right): → false (i = 0, j = 1)
out, i, j = [], 0, 0 — nums is now [3, 1, 3, 0]; mid = 2; 1 pushed on the front of left; right gets 3 appended; …
while i < len(left) and j < len(right): → true (i = 0, j = 0)
if left[i] <= right[j]: → false (i = 0, j = 0) (<= keeps it stable)
while i < len(left) and j < len(right): → true (i = 0, j = 1)
if left[i] <= right[j]: → true (i = 0, j = 1) (<= keeps it stable)
while i < len(left) and j < len(right): → true (i = 1, j = 1)
if left[i] <= right[j]: → true (i = 1, j = 1) (<= keeps it stable)
while i < len(left) and j < len(right): → false (i = 2, j = 1)

chapters.title: Quicksort, random pivot, three-way partition

frames.caption: Quicksort, random pivot, three-way partition — O(n log n) expected time, O(log n) expected extra space. Input: sort_array(nums=[3, 1, 3, 0]). Step through to watch the code work on this input.
lt, i, gt = lo, lo, hi — lt = 0; i = 0; gt = 3 (< pivot | == pivot | unseen | > pivot)
nums[gt], nums[i] = nums[i], nums[gt]; gt -= 1 — swap nums[0] and nums[3]; gt = 2
nums[gt], nums[i] = nums[i], nums[gt]; gt -= 1 — swap nums[1] and nums[2]; gt = 1
if lt - lo < hi - gt: → true (gt = 0, hi = 3, lo = 0, lt = 0) (recurse on the smaller side)
lt, i, gt = lo, lo, hi — lt = 1; gt = 3 (< pivot | == pivot | unseen | > pivot)
nums[gt], nums[i] = nums[i], nums[gt]; gt -= 1 — swap nums[1] and nums[2]; gt = 1
if lt - lo < hi - gt: → true (gt = 1, hi = 3, lo = 1, lt = 1) (recurse on the smaller side)
lt, i, gt = lo, lo, hi — lt = 2; gt = 3 (< pivot | == pivot | unseen | > pivot)
if lt - lo < hi - gt: → false (gt = 3, hi = 3, lo = 2, lt = 2) (recurse on the smaller side)
